scenarios.name: Close the appearance menu by switching tabs during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon uses Normal appearance
the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu
the user clicks the Tools tab while the submenu is open
the appearance submenu and panel context menu close
the part and editable sketch remain active and unchanged
the user selects the Sketch tab
sketch editing remains active and unchanged
